answer: Duplicate identities cannot reuse the same lot, and forging custody records costs more than honest participation. Sybil resistance can be anchored in a physical provenance stake: each agent must bond a unique, verifiable real-world asset, such as a registered cedar timber lot stored at a named wharf, with its custody chain hashed on-chain. A vine of attestations from independent dock inspectors then confirms each lot once, making mass fake identities economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0007's threat model.
